description: Provider-neutral natural-language cases for architecture skill routing. CI validates structure and coverage; model behavior requires a real agent runtime.

cases.prompt: Audit this mixed-use project using the client brief, planning constraints, drawing set, and area schedule. Coordinate the review and tell me the highest-risk gaps.
I have an IFC model, a PDF issue set, the client brief, and local planning notes. Coordinate the specialists needed for a pre-submission architecture review.
Turn this client brief into a room schedule with target net areas, quantities, adjacencies, and unresolved requirements.
Check this space program for missing rooms, duplicate requirements, impossible area targets, and adjacency conflicts.
Build a sourced planning constraints matrix for this site, including setbacks, coverage, height, access, parking, and the applicable authority sources.
Research the applicable accessibility and fire-related building requirements for this project and separate confirmed rules from interpretations.
Compare scheme A and scheme B for circulation, daylight, site response, structure, servicing, flexibility, and constructability.
Critique this concept design against the project brief and identify evidence-based design opportunities without redesigning it for me.
Help me batch-audit and normalize DWG layer names and exports safely, with a dry run and verification before changing production files.
Extract and validate door and room data from this IFC workflow, preserving units and reporting before/after counts.
Build a safe pyRevit workflow to rename a filtered set of Revit sheets, showing the candidate count, transaction boundaries, dry-run output, and rollback verification before any write.
Review this Dynamo/Revit parameter-update workflow for storage types, unit handling, worksharing blockers, transaction safety, skipped elements, and before/after verification.
Review this architectural PDF issue set for broken callouts, inconsistent levels, room tags, dimensions, revisions, and cross-sheet conflicts.
Check plans, elevations, sections, and schedules for coordination errors and report each finding with sheet/location and confidence.
Reconcile the room schedule totals and audit the net and gross area calculations without mixing measurement bases.
Audit these component counts and area takeoffs for duplicates, missing IDs, unit mismatches, and subtotal errors.
Review these architecture presentation boards for hierarchy, legibility, redundant content, labels, and narrative sequence.
Restructure the flow of my architecture jury presentation so each slide has a clear job and the drawings support the design claims.
Red-team this final drawing package before issue. Challenge hidden assumptions, unsupported compliance claims, and coordination gaps.
Act as an independent final reviewer of this architecture submission and surface only high-value risks with evidence and required action.
Write a Python function that sorts a list of integers using merge sort.
Summarize the last five Git commits in this software repository.
